title: Yomi Rework
notes: Yomi: shorter, more dangerous fights. Enemies have 40% less HP and deal 60% more damage; floors rise half a level each, circles 3.5 levels (circle 1 starts at Lv 146).
Yomi Arena fighters are a real exam after their circle.
Recommended power for Paragon, Yomi circles and the Yomi Arena now matches real wins (it was up to 10x too high).
